headline: Government moves to introduce emergency power over leveraged ETFs… Opposition demands "apology"
summary: The government has begun amending the Capital Markets Act to create an emergency measures power that would let it adjust the leverage multiple of single-stock leveraged ETFs. The opposition has launched a coordinated attack on the plan.
why: Leveraged ETFs amplify daily returns of underlying stocks, so rules on their leverage affect trading volumes and risk in Korean equity markets. Korea's Capital Markets Act governs securities trading and fund products.
